activity.notes: Dular Bombogor was an Evenk/Solon chief who led resistance in the Amur basin against Qing expansion. Modern scholarship describes the relevant political formation as a Daur-Evenk federation (also subsumed in Manchu records under the collective Solon designation) and identifies Bombogor as its last leader, defeated and captured in 1640. ATLAS therefore does not flatten the federation into a generic timeless 'Evenks' polity.
